books.label: SPY daily put spread
books.stop: none: the worst case is capped by the $5-wide spread
books.purpose: Roy, 2026-10-07: "make profits daily ... trade regardless of anything". Sells a $5-wide SPY put spread expiring the same day, one remaining-day move below the price (VIX-sized), every day SPY has a same-day expiry; bought back at 15:40. The worst case is capped at the width minus the credit (about $470). Backtest (backtests/spreads.md, credits priced at the VIX, likely generous): won about 95% of days; this book prices with Alpaca's real quotes. 2026-10-07 10:25: real quotes paid only $3-7 one move below the price (the backtest assumed ~$34), so the short strike moved to half a move below for a meaningful credit.

books.label: SPY shares
books.purpose: The idea that turned the desk's own signals profitable in the 6-year backtest (backtests/ideas.md): whole shares, the stop held at Alpaca.

books.label: SNDK shares
books.stop: 0.25 × the stock's average daily range (20 days)
books.purpose: Roy's pick (2026-10-07). Same rules as SPY shares; the stop is a quarter of SNDK's average daily range (SPY's 0.25% in SNDK's terms). See backtests/ideas-sndk.md.

books.label: SPY options (learning)
books.purpose: Kept so the learner keeps learning options. Lost money in the backtest (backtests/current.md); paper only.
